topic: GTA 6: no official first-person mode, the phone-camera trick players found, and GTA 5's first-person arriving a year late
title: GTA 6's secret camera is hiding behind your phone #shorts
lines: Can you actually play GTA 6 in first person?
Officially, no. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said the team focused on third person animations instead.
But within days of launch, players found a back door.
Get in a car, open your phone, close it, then rapidly tap the camera button.
The view snaps into first person and stays there.
The catch? The only way back out is reloading your save.
But here's the twist. GTA 5 launched without first person too.
It only arrived over a year later, in November 2014, on PS4 and Xbox One.
So if Rockstar did it once, the real question is still this.
description: GTA 6 has no first-person mode, yet players already found a way in through the phone. And GTA 5 history says the story may not end there. #gta6 #gtavi #gaming #gtatips #shorts
